desc: Designed in collaboration with Shadow Systems and John Lovell of Warrior Poet Society. The War Poet line up is based off the Shadow Systems pistols with exclusive WPS color and brand elements. These pistols feature differentiating slide machining with aggressive serrations and weight balancing window. All War Poet pistols come standard with the patented Shadow Systems multi-footprint optic cut. The CR920P is Shadow System's subcompact model designed to shoot like a full-size pistol. The CR920P utilizes a proprietary barrel with a cam-locking compensator. Simply depress a detent, install compensator, twist on and latch in place.
